searchText: Hello, whom can hook me up with a large amount of Sepolia Eth ? We want to setup a validator cluster for SecureRpc Relay testing sepolia is gated, so you can’t stake with sep eth wat am i to do then :((((( we want support this yes , whom must i appeal to yes probably <@199561711278227457> i shall christen our graffiti with the name of your handle ser Danke You'd have to follow the instructions and post here: https://github.com/eth-clients/sepolia/issues/12 But the existing validator set has decided that its a bad idea to make the validator set in sepolia bigger unless there are really good reasons to do so as each new entity makes it harder to co-ordinate upgrades. If there's a strong reason to host validators, we can help you host more validators on Goerli or show you how to setup your own private testnets. Additionally there's an upcoming ephermeral testnet idea that a lot of community members are working on, perhaps that could also be a good fit. We need Sepolia i give you my phone number to text me no problem i am always available habibi Is there some specific reason you need to run validators on sepolia? excerpts.content:
You'd have to follow the instructions and post here: https://github.com/eth-clients/sepolia/issues/12

But the existing validator set has decided that its a bad idea to make the validator set in sepolia bigger unless there are really good reasons to do so as each new entity makes it harder to co-ordinate upgrades. If there's a strong reason to host validators, we can help you host more validators on Goerli or show you how to setup your own private testnets. Additionally there's an upcoming ephermeral testnet idea that a lot of community members are working on, perhaps that could also be a good fit.
